description.value: Bonjour Vietnam Bistro is a Vietnamese restaurant and cocktail bar on Fraser Street in Vancouver, blending traditional dishes like Beef Pho, Bánh Xèo, and fresh rolls with a curated cocktail menu featuring both classic and creative originals. The space accommodates up to 60 guests and hosts private events and parties. Online ordering is available alongside dine-in service.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 37m; rack (3 spaces) at 41m; stands (2 spaces) at 73m; stands (2 spaces) at 78m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the OSM contact details (phone, address). The menu page includes a dedicated VEGETARIAN section with 8+ items, and the navigation bar prominently features 'Order Online', confirming takeout availability. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags, so those fields are null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Bonjour Vietnam Bistro' but the website consistently uses 'Bonjour Vietnam Bistro & Cocktail Bar' — the OSM name is truncated.
Website shows a postal code typo in two places ('V5V E4E' vs. the correct 'V5V 4E4'); corrected address used.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is an active, well-presented Food & Drink business that would serve touring cyclists, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. A physical site visit or direct contact is needed to verify these before listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated VEGETARIAN section on the menu with 8+ items including tofu spring rolls, fresh rolls, mushroom wonton, eggplant, stir-fried bok choy, spicy lemongrass tofu, crispy turmeric pancake, and mango salad

wow_evidence: Vietnamese restaurant and cocktail bar on Fraser Street

price.label: Casual
price.signal: Mains $22–28: pho, noodle soups, stir-fries, rice dishes. Shaken beef $34 outlier.
